customManagers.description: Annotated *_VERSION pins in the install scripts. The paired sha256 is not updated, so the build fails its checksum until the pin is refreshed by hand

packageRules.description: prek-action's prek-version and mise.toml pin the same prek, so one pull request bumps both
Provider and Terraform updates change every later plan, bootstrap's included, so they wait for review

Merging any path terraform-apply.yml triggers on applies it, so these wait for review. Renovate automerges a branch only when every upgrade in it qualifies, so one matching file holds the whole pull request. Lists every terraform-apply.yml paths entry
